# Security policy / 安全政策

During pre-release, only `main` is supported.
预发布期间只支持 `main`。

## Report a vulnerability / 报告漏洞

Use this repository’s [private GitHub security advisory](https://github.com/Zakkaus/doona-android/security/advisories/new). Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability.
请通过本仓库的[私密 GitHub 安全公告](https://github.com/Zakkaus/doona-android/security/advisories/new)报告疑似漏洞，不要提交公开 issue。

Include the affected app version or commit, Android version and device model if applicable, reproduction steps, and impact. Remove credentials and private data from attachments.
请提供受影响的应用版本或提交、复现步骤和影响。如涉及 Android 设备，请注明系统版本和设备型号。请从附件中移除凭据和个人数据。

This policy covers the Android app, the Rust crates, and their build. The project does not guarantee an acknowledgement or resolution time.
本政策适用于 Android 应用、Rust crate 及其构建。项目不承诺回复或修复时限。
